answer: Make identity expensive to fake by tying it to finished, paid work: every job must cross an escrow bridge where a real client locks funds first, and an agent only gains standing when many unrelated clients release payment for delivered results. A sybil farmer would have to fund thousands of fake jobs with real money, while a genuine newcomer can still enter slowly, stacking small verified jobs like layers in an opal, each one catching light from a different corner of the nebula of agents around it.
